guidetextdraw._value: Please complete this form to request that a declined fee waiver application be accepted and applied for the term specified. It is the student’s responsibility to pay for any charges due on their account while the Appeals Committee is reviewing this request. All fee waiver appeals must be submitted to the Appeals Review Committee within one year from the term being appealed (i.e., fall, spring, summer).
